data.street_address: South Dock, Wood Wharf, London, E14 9SF

description.text:
Now open in South Dock…

The Boathouse London is delighted to announce the launch of its new and exclusive events space in the heart of Canary Wharf. Designed in partnership with MADE.COM, this unique venue sits alongside the exciting new Wood Wharf development and becomes the latest addition to their existing fleet of luxury boats throughout London.

Inspired by intimate speakeasies and chic Parisian jazz clubs, music sits at the heart of the boat’s ethos with a calendar of music events and live lounge sessions with new and upcoming artists set to be unveiled soon. As well as ticketed events, the venue is also available for private hire and open to the public from Wednesday to Saturday. 

To book or to enquire about exclusive hire please email bookings@boathouselondon.co.uk
